name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task sentence 'Taking the key means you must open the door too' is the 'a means b too / as well' no-timing condition, which maps directly to RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open); both propositions are declared and match the task's key and door, 'must' makes the clause hard, and since open-the-door is the consequent of a condition rather than an unconditional command, the rule-only machine with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: If the agent has the door key, the door must also be opened at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
